title: Geologic map of the Paris Mountain quadrangle, Greenville County, South Carolina
citation: Niewendorp, C.A., Garihan, J.M., and Clendenin, C.W., Jr., 2010, Geologic map of the Paris Mountain quadrangle, Greenville County, South Carolina: South Carolina Geological Survey Open-File Report OFR-158, map scale 1:24,000.
notes: Single OCR'd Piedmont map sheet with no cross section; map face is OCR noise. Map symbols other than Qal (ss, ms, grgn, mbgn, TRg, q, am, mgr, um) are not legible in the OCR and not recorded per unit. Thrust faults, a synform and an antiform are drawn on the map face (checked on a page-image crop) and recorded by kind with their explanation certainty; their locations are not recorded. Oblique-slip faults are in the explanation but were not seen in the crop viewed. Numerous foliation, cleavage and lineation measurements on the map face are too small to read reliably and are not recorded. Authors printed 'Niewendrop'. SUBSURFACE: none.
